tab.newSame: New tab, same shell and folder (Ctrl+Shift+T)
split.divider: Drag to resize · double-click: even split
term.exited: shell exited — press Enter to restart it
scrub.tip: Drag up/down to scroll · double-click: jump to the bottom
link.file: Ctrl+Click: open file · Ctrl+Shift+Click: show in Explorer
close.tab.title: Agent is mid-task
close.tab.body: "{name}" is still running. Closing the tab interrupts it.
close.app.busyBody: Closing Mooring interrupts the agents that are working. Their sessions reopen next time, but the turn in progress is lost.
close.app.idleBody: Closing Mooring stops these agents. Next time, each tab resumes its own session.
sc.title: Keyboard shortcuts
sc.newTab: New tab, same shell and folder
sc.tabMenu: Colour, pin, side by side, close
sc.splitRight: Split left | right with a new tab
sc.splitDown: Split top / bottom with a new tab
sc.splitWith: Open that tab side by side
sc.scrub: Pull further to scroll faster · double-click: bottom
sc.esc: Close dialogs, menus, the find bar
share.done: Pasted the context of “{name}” — type your question and press Enter
share.screen: Pasted the visible text of “{name}” (its chat history can't be read)
sc.k.dragToTerm: Drag a tab onto a terminal
sc.share: Paste that tab's context into the chat there
share.noChat: “{name}” has no agent chatting to receive it
restore.title: Reopen last time's {n} tabs?
restore.body: Pick the tabs to reopen, each in its old folder.
restore.bodyAgents: Pick the tabs to reopen. A tab with an agent resumes its session; for one left out the session stays queued, and agent-resume picks it up later.
sc.palette: Command palette: jump to a tab, run a command
waiting.title: Waiting sessions
waiting.forgetAllBody: Mooring stops offering these sessions and won't reopen them. Their chats stay in Claude/Codex (claude --resume still opens them).
